stations.name: Tarana Tamil

stations.name: Lotus FM
stations.evidenceNotes: Official Lotus live-player HTML data-data is base64-encoded plaintext JSON. Nested stations entry explicitly names Lotus Live Radio with this exact LOTUSFMAAC endpoint. Outer widget title says Motsweding Live: retained template inconsistency, not used to select MOTSWEDINGAAC. One South African multilingual scheduled Tamil service, not a 24-hour Tamil channel.
